div.div: مِخْبَصَةٌ A spoon, or thing like a spoon, with which خَبِيص is made; (S, as in two different copies;) a spoon with which خبيص is stirred about, or turned over, (A, L, K,) in the [vessel called] طِنْجِير: (K:) or the thing in which خبيص is stirred about, or turned over. (L, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
